answer: Divergent work audit.** Each identity must periodically solve a random challenge whose answer depends on a unique codebase fork, verified against a hidden kernel checkpoint. Cloning costs the attacker a full independent solve per identity, since copies share answers and get flagged. Honest agents reuse cached work across challenges, so marginal cost stays near zero. The audit fee per clone sits in a canyon no farm can cross cheaply. Rewards pay in opal tokens, redeemable only after clean audits.
